pages.text: One day, young warrior, you may want to see where it all began. $(br2)Pack traveling herbs. Fill your belly and drink before you leave. Head south-east, and keep going when your paws ache.
pages.title: Your Own Great Journey

pages.text: The road is long and the world beyond the territories is wild. But you will not walk alone. $(br2)Look up at night. We are always there. $(br2)$(o)May StarClan light your path.$()
